profile_md: York has no single institution-wide employer project requirement, but a distributed set of curricular live-client team routes. The strongest central routes are the York Interdisciplinary Modules and the Community Engaged Learning (CEL) team: the **Sustainability Clinic** (20-credit elective for 3rd-year undergraduates and postgraduates, plus a core version in Environment and Geography) puts multidisciplinary teams to work for external clients (charities, councils, community groups, businesses) on live sustainability problems, with a facilitator and a reflective report; about 65 partner organisations and 450+ students are reported cumulatively. The Climate Crisis Action Lab used campaign-group briefs but is stated as not running in 2026/27. CEL also underpins department-based modules: the core Year 2 **Public History Project** (History) and Psychology's **Community Action Project** both put small teams on external-partner briefs; CEL reported 158 partners, 1,424 students and 61 projects in 2024/25. In business, the School for Business and Society runs a six-week undergraduate group consultancy for external clients linked to a 20-credit module, and MSc Management offers a live business project route; Environment and Geography's MSc Group Sustainable Business Project is core to its Sustainable Business MSc with business partners. Law, Education and Computer Science have candidate routes (migrants' rights clinic, STEP 1, integrated-masters group project) that are incompletely evidenced. Most routes are programme- or elective-bound; none is compulsory university-wide. Uncertain: several undated pages, mixed internal/external partners (Beyond the Book), and extent of external customers in Computer Science.
gaps: Further departmental CEL instances likely (12 CEL taught modules across three faculties reported; only four identified). Not verified: SPY00033I Community Practice Experience; Biology, Politics, Sociology, Music, Archaeology, HYMS/Health Sciences modules; Education STEP 1 and MSc Management live-project route need dated corroboration; Law migrants' rights clinic needs current-year evidence; whether UG consultancy page maps directly to MAN00019H; computer science external-customer coverage.
